description: Put items into, or take items out of, the currently-open furnace. `slot` selects input/fuel/output; `op` is put or take. Output cannot be put into. Requires an open furnace (open_furnace first).

count.description: Count to put (default 1; ignored for take)

op.description: Put items in or take items out

slot.description: Which furnace slot to act on

name: furnace_action
